text:
rachel: Found plain DB creds in partner chart upload to staging charts bucket: gs://redwood-staging-charts/partner-omega/1.0.0/values.yaml -> DB_URL=postgresql://ingest:plainpwd@staging-db:5432/ingest

samir: Oof. Which path exactly?

rachel: pasted above. It's under `extra.env`. I pulled the file to gs://sec-evidence/INC-3487654321/values.yaml and removed public ACL.

eli: How did it bypass scanning? Partner pushed directly with their SA to the bucket. Our ingest pipeline wasn't used.

oncall: Initial triage: staging-only for now. No prod references in the file. Will remove partner SA write permissions.

sec-bot: Incident INC-3487654321 opened. Triage lead: @samir. Follow secrets-rotation runbook.

samir: Quick plan: (1) lock down bucket write, move offending object to quarantine; (2) rotate staging DB user and publish new creds to Vault KV; (3) search logs for any use of that DB user; (4) check Vault for wrapped artifacts tied to current transit key and plan rewrap if present.

ops-bot: IAM change initiated by oncall at 3487654365 - removed roles/storage.objectCreator from partner-ci@partner.example for gs://redwood-staging-charts. Object moved to gs://sec-evidence/INC-3487654321/.

eli: Running log search now: `gcloud logging read 'textPayload:"ingest"' --limit=500`

samir: I'll take DB rotation. Use ephemeral username pattern `ingest_rot_<ts>`. Keep old secret in Vault but mark as deprecated for 72h. Canary via ConfigSync to one pod. Revoke old creds after canary stable.

rachel: Snapshotting audit logs before any rewrap: `gcloud logging read 'logName="projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fdata_access"' --start-time="2026-04-02T00:00:00Z" --format=json > /tmp/audit-snap.json`

eli: Found Vault entries under `secret/data/partner-omega` referencing a `wrapped_blob` and transit key `transit-main-v2`.

samir: OK we will provision a temporary KMS key alias `rewrap-temp-3487`, grant `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` to vault-service, then run our rewrap utility `bin/kv-rewrap --from=transit-main-v2 --to=rewrap-temp-3487` in maintenance window. Snapshot audits pre/post.

oncall: Applying short-term RBAC: restrict Vault transit encrypt/decrypt to `vault-service` and ops-audit group read-only. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/912 (small policy change).

ops-bot: PR 912 pushed by samir at 3487654440. Requesting quick review.

rachel: grep of ingress logs shows only internal cluster IPs authenticating with `ingest` user in last 7 days. No external IPs so far.

samir: Good. Proceed with rotate. Eli please watch for `authentication failed` spikes. Threshold rollback: >5% auth failures in 10m window.

eli: Rotation started at 3487654460: `./infra/scripts/pg-rotate-user.sh --db=staging-db --user=ingest --to=ingest_rot_3487654460`

ops-bot: New credentials written to Vault at `secret/data/staging/db/ingest_rot_3487654460` and old secret marked `deprecated`.

ops-bot: ConfigSync canary deployment triggered at 3487654488 - target: staging, 1 pod.

rachel: Canary pod accepted new creds and connected ok. Monitoring 15m.

samir: While canary runs, prepare KMS rewrap. I'll coordinate execution window at +30m. Make sure audit snapshot is uploaded to sec-evidence.

eli: Audit snapshot uploaded to gs://sec-evidence/INC-3487654321/audit-snap.json

oncall: Partner CI attempted another upload but was routed to quarantine bucket; no plaintext detected.

samir: Canary healthy. Proceeding to revoke old DB user at 3487654720.

ops-bot: Old user `ingest` revoked at 3487654720.

samir: Starting rewrap now: provisioned key `rewrap-temp-3487`, running `bin/kv-rewrap --paths=secret/data/partner-omega --from=transit-main-v2 --to=rewrap-temp-3487` (orchestrator).

rachel: Watching telemetry for decrypt errors. Alert rule `staging.decrypt.failures` set to notify oncall if >1 error/min.

eli: Rewrap completed with 0 decrypt failures observed in telemetry. Audit snapshot after rewrap uploaded.

sec-bot: INC-3487654321 update: rotation and rewrap complete, old secrets revoked, partner SA write restricted. Follow-ups: infra to add server-side scanning on chart ingest; partner-security to update onboarding checklist.

samir: I'll schedule a 30-min postmortem with partner-security and infra to discuss ingestion gating and automated scanning. Rachel will draft retro.

rachel: Drafting retro and short-runbook for partner uploads now. Will post link when ready.

ops-bot: Closing incident INC-3487654321 at 3487654800 - closure note: staging-only exposure contained; creds rotated; KMS rewrap done; RBAC and pipeline mitigations in progress.
